checks.check: every port of sn64_board_top has a ball, and no ball is given twice
43 cartridge outputs reach their own socket pin through a channel that points to the cartridge
D0-D7 reach their socket pins through one byte whose direction is data_dir and whose enable is data_oe_n
the four level-shifter enables are pulled to 3.3 V, so every byte is off until the FPGA drives them
data_dir is pulled low, so the data byte points away from the cartridge until the FPGA drives it
4 cartridge inputs come from their own socket pin through a channel that points to the FPGA and is switched by sense_oe_n
level shifters: every byte enable is driven by the FPGA, and no pin that can float for long is left open (TI SCAS416Q sections 3 and 10)
supply converter: address pin open (0x10), I2C lines pulled up and on their balls, supplies, DECAP capacitor, cartridge supply on input 3
the open-drain pulls (CIC data, /RESET) go through the SN74LVC07A to the right pins, with pull-ups; unused gates are tied off and none is on PROGRAMN
4 level shifters: A side on 3.3 V, B side on the cartridge 5 V, eight grounds each
socket +5 V pins on the switched cartridge supply, socket grounds on ground
checks.detail: socket +5 V net SNES_5V_CART, switch ['U12'] output SNES_5V_CART

checks.check: the cartridge switch is off until the FPGA turns it on (enable pulled low, driven by cart_5v_enable)
27 N64 signals on their own edge fingers; 3.3 V fingers feed the power mux; 12 V fingers left open
configuration flash on the configuration balls; CFG = 010 (master SPI); DONE, INITN, PROGRAMN pulled up
the 27 MHz oscillator output is on the osc_27 ball and the supervisor output on board_reset_n

USB: D+ and D- each through 27 ohm to the loader chip and to nothing else, 47 pF on each; the chip on VBUS with VCCIO and RESET# on its own 3.3 V output; its serial and CBUS pins open; 5.1 k on each CC pin

JTAG: the loader chip is on the FPGA JTAG balls as openFPGALoader drives it (TCK = DSR#, TMS = DCD#, TDI = RI#, TDO = CTS#), nothing else is; TMS, TDI, TDO pulled up, TCK pulled down, a test pad on each
telemetry converter on the I2C ports with pull-ups; its channel 3 on the cartridge rail (20 k / 10 k), as the cartridge check needs
cartridge sound: each socket pin through a capacitor and a resistor to its comparator ball, feedback through an RC to the other ball
every pad of the board is on the net the schematic gives it (194 parts)
FPGA supply and ground balls on their rails, ports on user I/O balls, configuration, clock and comparator balls as the Lattice table names them
5 V converter: enable through a resistor, a 0603 capacitor on its input and on its output; measuring chip: 1 uF on each supply pin
40 capacitors are at the pin they serve (3.5 mm at most, the few exceptions named in the tool; nearest to its limit: C41 3.3 of 3.5 mm)
no FPGA ball carries a signal that the logic has no port for (JTAG and the two comparator return balls apart)
